info.title: FlixQuest Scraper API
info.description: Exhaustive OpenAPI specification for FlixQuest Scraper API v2, designed for integration with Flutter applications.

tags.name: Providers
tags.description: Operations for listing and managing scraper provider states.

tags.name: Streams
tags.description: Operations for scraping movie and TV episode stream links.

tags.name: Configuration
tags.description: Runtime playback configuration consumed by FlixQuest clients.

tags.name: DLHD
tags.description: Live channel, HLS extraction, and categorized EPG operations for DLHD.

tags.name: Subtitles
tags.description: Subtitle search across the configured providers, plus the passthrough that serves the files.

tags.name: Proxy
tags.description: Stream proxy pass-through endpoint for video playback.

get.description: Returns the optional branded video played before official streams.

500.description: The server intro environment variables are invalid.

get.description: Retrieves the list of active (and optionally disabled) video scraper providers.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to include disabled providers in the response.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Alias for 'all'. Set to 'true' to include disabled providers.

parameters.name: fProxy
parameters.description: Forward proxy configuration mode or proxy URL.

get.description: Returns the latest persisted fifteen-minute stream check for every enabled provider.

503.description: No provider health snapshot is available yet.

patch.description: Enables or disables a specific scraper provider by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique provider identifier (e.g. 'vixsrc').

post.description: Toggles the enabled status of a provider, or sets it explicitly if provided in the body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique provider identifier.

get.description: Fetches validated playback stream links for a movie by TMDB ID using a selected provider.

parameters.name: tmdbId
parameters.description: The TMDB ID of the movie (e.g. '556574').

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The provider identifier to scrape streams from (e.g. 'vixsrc').

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Set to 'true' or '1' to exhaust every available server from this provider. Defaults to the first available server path.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Set to 'false' or '0' to disable proxying and retrieve raw URLs when possible.

parameters.name: noProxy
parameters.description: Set to 'true' or '1' to bypass stream URL proxying.

parameters.name: fProxy
parameters.description: Forward proxy setting (boolean or HTTP proxy string).

400.description: Missing or invalid tmdbId or provider parameter.

404.description: Provider not found, disabled, or no streams found.

get.description: Fetches validated playback stream links for a TV episode by TMDB ID, season, and episode using a selected provider.

parameters.name: tmdbId
parameters.description: The TMDB ID of the TV show (e.g. '2316').

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season number (positive integer).

parameters.name: episode
parameters.description: Episode number (positive integer).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The provider identifier to scrape streams from (e.g. 'vixsrc').

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Set to 'true' or '1' to exhaust every available server from this provider. Defaults to the first available server path.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Set to 'false' or '0' to disable stream proxying.

parameters.name: noProxy
parameters.description: Set to 'true' or '1' to bypass stream URL proxying.

parameters.name: fProxy
parameters.description: Forward proxy setting (boolean or HTTP proxy string).

404.description: Provider not found, disabled, or no streams found.

post.description: Estimates storage bytes for a stream link returned by stream-movie or stream-tv. Only signed size tokens are accepted; clients cannot submit arbitrary upstream URLs or headers.

200.description: Fast storage estimate from manifest bitrate metadata, or up to seven distributed HLS range probes when bitrate metadata is missing.

400.description: The token is missing, invalid, expired, or points to a disallowed destination.

502.description: The upstream stream objects could not be inspected.

get.description: Searches every configured subtitle provider and returns one combined catalog for a movie or episode. Each entry's `url` points back at this API, so clients never contact a subtitle host directly and never need provider credentials. Entries are deduplicated by `id`. Responses are privately cacheable for 5 minutes.

parameters.name: tmdbId
parameters.description: TMDB id of the movie or show.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season number. Required together with `episode` for shows.

parameters.name: episode
parameters.description: Episode number. Required together with `season` for shows.

400.description: Missing or invalid `tmdbId`, or only one of `season` and `episode`.

get.description: Serves one subtitle track, converted to WebVTT (or SubRip) with aggregator advertisement cues removed and the body re-encoded to UTF-8. URLs for this endpoint are returned in `subtitles[].url` from a search and in `links[].subtitles[].file` when a scraping provider supplies no subtitles of its own; clients should not construct them by hand. Responses allow any origin and are cacheable for 24 hours.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Subtitle provider that owns the id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Provider-specific subtitle id with a `.vtt` or `.srt` extension.

parameters.name: l
parameters.description: ISO 639 language hint used to decode non-UTF-8 uploads.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Signed token identifying the upstream file. Required for `wyzie`, whose files live on third-party hosts behind per-download tokens rather than stable ids. Issued by a search or stream response, signed with `STREAM_PROXY_SECRET`, and valid for 12 hours.

400.description: Malformed subtitle path, or a missing, expired or tampered token.

502.description: The upstream subtitle host failed or returned an unusable file.

get.description: Scrapes the current 24/7 channel directory from DLHD.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive channel name or ID filter.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Set to true to bypass the channel cache.

get.summary: Extract a DLHD Channel HLS Stream
get.description: Resolves a numeric DLHD channel ID to a validated, short-lived M3U8 URL and the Origin, Referer, and User-Agent headers required for playback.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric DLHD channel ID.

200.description: Fresh HLS URL and playback headers. The response is not cacheable.

400.description: The channel ID is not numeric.

502.description: No current playable M3U8 could be extracted.

get.description: Returns the DLHD schedule grouped by day, category, event, and playable channels.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Schedule date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Case-insensitive category filter.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search event titles, times, and channel names.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Set to true to bypass the EPG cache.

get.description: Proxies video files, HLS manifests/segments, or DASH manifests using a signed JWT/HMAC token to pass required custom headers.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Signed base64url token containing stream URL, headers, expiration, and HLS/DASH filter directives.

200.description: Video stream content (M3U8, MPD, TS segment, or MP4 video).

content.description: Human-readable summary of what this provider can stream, shown to users when they pick a source.

enabled.description: True to enable provider, false to disable.
Optional boolean to set status. If omitted, status will be toggled.

url.description: Absolute URL of this API's subtitle passthrough.

display.description: Human label. Carries `(MT)` and `#n` markers so same-language alternatives stay distinguishable.

encoding.description: Always `UTF-8`; the passthrough re-encodes upstream files.

flagUrl.description: Flag image for the language, or an empty string when unmapped.

media.description: Title reported by the provider, or an empty string.

release.description: Release or file name the subtitle was timed against.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers required when bypassing the stream proxy.

hlsVariant.description: Internal proxy instruction for HLS master playlist variant filtering.

hlsAudioLanguage.description: Internal proxy instruction for default HLS audio language selection.

dashVideoHeight.description: Internal proxy instruction for DASH video height filtering.

sizeToken.description: Signed token for estimating the selected stream's source bytes before download.

requiresProxy.description: Indicates whether anti-hotlink restrictions force this stream through the proxy.

token.description: The sizeToken returned on the selected ProviderLink.

estimatedBytes.description: Estimated storage bytes for the selected stream.

bitrate.description: Declared aggregate bitrate in bits per second.

url.description: A validated, short-lived HLS master playlist URL.

headers.description: Headers required for the HLS master, variants, and segments.
